notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.2
notes.content:
CHANGES
 Added 3 additional tracks for background playback
 Game character is now able to reload weapons by himself
 A flashlight has been added to the game character at the “Warehouse (hard)” level

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.1
notes.content:
CHANGES
 Each firearm automatically upgrades to level 3 after the sixth wave of zombies. Now it’s not necessary to play with only 1-2 weapons all rounds
 Added 6 additional tracks for background playback
 Fat zombies now do damage to other zombies again
 Fixed minor bugs


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36377458/05d373a46f2028c06ac11d6adf51138eb77ca5f7.png

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.0
notes.content:
Warning! In this update, I tried to use a different method of compressing game files. The size of the game has increased to 6 GB (for updating you will have to download 2 GB). If this version of the game has become more unstable for you, then you can roll back to the previous version of the game in the "Beta" - "old_version" section.

CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION
Now you can change the character's gloves. One-time purchase (8000 pts.). When you open character customization, you can choose 2 free skins for each character for free!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36377458/97ba70a8cf0829fb3772032a15e23b0cbbb68ab1.png

WEAPON BALANCE
Some weapon characteristics was updated.

BUG FIX
General bugs fix. Basically, work was done on crashes and sounds.
If you find a new bug or error, please inform me about this in the discussions for the game.

I wish you a pleasant game!

notes.title: FIRST FREE UPDATE
notes.content:
PLAYERS MAY DOWNLOAD VERSION 1.1.0 FOR FREE
Finally, I was able to finish the first update for Everyone Dies! ːSteamhappyː
I tried to take into account all the relevant requests and complaints of the players.

WEAPONS
New weapons:
  Saiga-12k (randomizer)
 M1A1 Thompson (randomizer)
 ASH-12 MOD (randomizer)
 AK74M (wall)

Modified weapons:

 AUG (randomizer)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36377458/46457c2785fb4937dda58109f194b943903a39ac.png

GAME LEVELS
  Added a new game level - Cargo. The location is a small arena, divided into 3 parts. You need to think quickly in order to survive.
 Now 3 main levels (Bunker, Warehouse and Cargo) are available to everyone for free, without being forced to spend pts.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36377458/8f91f09053b022bf15bfeca099ef4b9ccf886f4c.png

GAMEPLAY
  Zombies are faster and more dangerous.
 Weapon Randomizer now does not give out weapons that can be bought from the wall (except for double-barreled sawed-off shotgun).
 Game prices have been adjusted.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36377458/2e0f985b5a3093e5e84369d0925dab12a014d737.png
 

If you find any bugs, please report this by creating a new topic in the discussions of the community center. After the release of the game, I test the game completely alone, and sometimes I can miss important errors.

Have a good game!

notes.title: The first free update in development!
notes.content:
Now I am actively developing a new update for Everyone Dies. You will find new content, as well as fixing unpleasant moments from the previous version.

During development, I try to take into all the wishes and complaints of the players. First of all, players will receive new weapons and a new game level for free. I also plan to rework the game balance a bit and improve it in some aspects. Some in-game item prices are also subject to change.

There is no specific release date for the update, but I will try not to delay it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36377458/46457c2785fb4937dda58109f194b943903a39ac.png
